name: Pro Form Builder
description: No-code builder for lead, intake and survey forms: field palette with native drag and drop, multi-page, per-field validation and options, visual conditional logic (react-querybuilder), undo/redo, live preview and Ajv-validated JSON schema output.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial schema (default: empty one-page form)

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new immutable schema after every edit

props.name: onSave
props.description: Shows a Save button; only called when the schema passes validation

props.name: asyncValidators
props.description: Server checks fields can reference; also used by the live preview

props.name: onPreviewSubmit
props.description: Receives submissions made in Preview mode
